data.name: Kufwat
data.gender_notes: Kufwat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Kufuwa' which means 'to be wise, powerful and strong'. The name Kufwat carries the meaning “Wise, Powerful, Strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kufwat usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, powerful, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Kufwat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Powerful, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kufwat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
